title.en: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure - Clamp in Wonderland: JoJo's Bizarre Married Life (Doujinshi)

altTitles.ja-ro: JoJo no Kimyou na Shinkon Seikatsu

altTitles.ja: ジョジョの奇妙な新婚生活

description.en:
Meet Jotaro Kujo and Noriyaki Kakyoin. Both high school students who have special powers called Stands, they traveled around the world to defeat the villainous DIO Brando and save Jotaro's mother Holy. But now… they're married?  
  
A doujin based on the Stardust Crusaders arc of the long running series JoJo's Bizarre Adventure. It's made by CLAMP, a group known for series like xxxHolic, Tsubasa: Reservoir Chronicle, and Cardcaptor Sakura. Because of its… content, it is considered a rite of passage for many a fledgling JoJo fan (alongside the infamous Duwang scans).  
  
Contains spoilers to Part 3.

biography.en:
CLAMP is a four-woman manga studio formed from the remaining members of the CLAMP doujinshi circle.

- [Ohkawa Ageha](https://mangadex.org/author/937ca459-3e37-450f-9114-ef81a37e335f/ohkawa-ageha) (leader; story & script)
- [Apapa Mokona](https://mangadex.org/author/259db6b3-3c79-4bbc-82f4-b65dde73e904/apapa-mokona) (lead artist; colorist)
- [Nekoi Tsubaki](https://mangadex.org/author/3dffe29e-f96d-446b-a288-84120d4f1297/nekoi-tsubaki) (art assistant; chibi artist)
- [Igarashi Satsuki](https://mangadex.org/author/93512b92-b84c-44df-8cfc-47182f6dcb98/igarashi-satsuki) (design; art assistant)
